scope: Agent-run hosted verification after successful CI deployment. Cooperative persistence compares the original saved history and previously collected C10 log snapshot, not a newly observed classroom session.

checks: Two isolated browser identities join from the visible interface and receive different folders
Eight cross-browser publications preserve the reader’s selected document and identify the actor
Identical nicknames remain distinguishable by role in the latest action and persisted history
Simultaneous UI moves produce one saved order and one visible conflict; both browsers converge
Timeline moves render in the other browser without reload
Both cooperative viewports pass axe A/AA checks with the live action and full chronology visible
Partner completion dismisses an obsolete explanation dialog and reveals the shared conclusion
Both identities recover shared evidence and solution after refresh
All 11 request-to-observed-render measurements below 1000ms
An initial history failure is visible and an explicit retry restores the first four links
A failed later page preserves existing links and reconnecting retries that same page
Saved files at 1920px have no horizontal overflow and pass axe A/AA
All thirteen investigations remain reachable from home, including the earliest saved publication
Saved files at 390px have no horizontal overflow and pass axe A/AA
Initial failure recovers on reconnect at phone width, and keyboard Show more reaches all files
A new browser sees an explicit empty history without another identity’s investigations
Entry shares the pending identity confirmation; a committed creation with a lost reply stays one room and is never silently retried
The uncertain creation links back to refreshed case files, where the original room is recoverable
A committed join with a lost reply retrieves the known room and preserves the same member and single archive seat
An unavailable identity check sends no creation; a second room is created only through the explicitly labelled choice
When join recovery also fails, the next action checks saved membership without posting another join
Original hosted browser identity restored
Original F1 publication retained
originalPersistence.limitations: Uses the original ignored test cookie; does not establish access from a new identity.

checks: Two separate same-name identities preserve member and role attribution
Repeat publication leaves version and saved time unchanged
Private partner clue rejected with 403
Stale timeline write rejected with 409
Real Fly multiline JSON formatted into seven committed actions and two rejections
Every committed action matched the persisted member, role, action and detail
Both original identities restore solved state and identical history
Formatted output omits nicknames, cookies and unknown detail
earlierCooperativePersistence.limitations: Automated HTTPS and real Fly log verification in an isolated test room; not a human classroom exercise. Local session cookies and raw logs are excluded from this report.
